name: Silent Assassin 🗡️
desc:
Protect the target, be the target, or assassinate the target, in this unique stealth-action game.

🔫 Level up and earn coins to unlock new guns, skins, gear, and perks.
🎯 Fulfil your daily missions and claim rewards.
🏆 Compete on monthly and all-time global leaderboards.
🎮 Available on PC, mobile, and console.
